title: Red Hat Security Advisory: rpm security update
description: Two moderate security vulnerabilities have been identified in the RPM Package Manager (RPM) used in Red Hat Enterprise Linux 9. These include a command injection vulnerability in the rpmbuild tool via an unescaped tarball path (CVE-2026-84837) and a macro injection vulnerability through crafted tar member names in rpmbuild's getTarSpec function (CVE-2026-78367). These issues could allow an attacker to execute arbitrary commands during package building. Red Hat has released security updates addressing these flaws.
